_SQL_RE = re.compile(
    r"""
    ^\s*
    SELECT\s+
    (?P<selected_columns>.+?)\s+
    FROM\s+
    (?P<table_name>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s+
    (?:WHERE\s+(?P<where_conditions>.+?))?\s*
    ;?\s*$
    """,
    re.IGNORECASE | re.VERBOSE,
)


def parse_sql(sql: str) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(sql, str):
        raise TypeError("sql must be a string")

    match = _SQL_RE.fullmatch(sql)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported SQL: {sql!r}")
